summary: Mobile parity test PASSED for the two rebuilt bespoke tools (Provider Price Checker + Contribution Estimator). All required testIDs render, backend endpoints return 200 with expected keys, primary CTAs have white label + icon on teal (light) / clay (dark) fill in both themes, and hero-card headline text on the teal/sage results is white in dark mode. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: ProviderPriceChecker.tsx uses r.service_code as the testID suffix only when present, falling back to r.service; consistent with server payload which includes service_code — OK.
ContributionEstimator.tsx: form has no min/max validation on service_mix percentages (they can sum to !=100). Not blocking, but worth guarding as UX polish.
Both files are >200 LOC but under 700-line threshold; well factored with local subcomponents (StatCard, ShareCard, RadioTile, Pill).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Provider Price Checker and Contribution Estimator on mobile have full parity with web. Verified flows: (1) PPC service picker lists 31 grouped services from /api/ppc/services; entering rate 120 for Personal care triggers pc-quality-guard (after-hours prompt) and pc-guard-continue reveals the full result including pc-how-this-compares (verdict red on 'above'), pc-position, pc-stream chip (Independence), pc-stat-charged $120, pc-your-share, pc-range $85-$115, pc-source-line, pc-how-this-works bullets; pc-grandfathered-checkbox toggles cleanly. (2) CE point path (post_nov_2025 + class_5 + full pension + single + homeowner) → POST /api/ce2/calculate returns 200 with contribution_weekly=$50.44, government_share_percent=93.38; result shows all headline + govt-share-bar + rate-breakdown + safety-net + oct-2026 + also-worth-knowing. Range path (not_assessed) renders ce-range-headline + min/max/anchors. Fee-exempt path (hcp_pre_sep_2024 + hcp_paid_fees=false) renders ce-fee-exempt-headline. Edit inputs returns to form. (3) CTA contrast: light bg=rgb(14,77,82) teal + white label/icon; dark bg=rgb(165,81,43) clay + white label/icon for BOTH pc-submit and ce-submit. (4) Dark mode: ce-result-headline uses primary teal bg with white/85% opacity text — readable. Remaining tools (letters-and-follow-ups, care-plan-reviewer/support-plan-reviewer, invoice-checker, family-coordinator) still on the old FormTool renderer as expected.
